dedupe_keys.name: webgis dike management system of vietnam directorate for dike management and disaster prevention

description: The WebGIS dike management system of the Vietnamese Directorate for Dike Management and Disaster Prevention holds information on river dikes from grade III up to the special grade, sea dikes, embankment dikes and some dike lines below grade III; on works on the dikes such as revetments, sluices, gates, dike watch posts and kilometre markers; on dike management units and storm and flood material stores; and on key dike points, for use in dike management and dike protection. The directorate sits in the Ministry of Agriculture and Environment in Hanoi. The public page is an introduction with a link to the login page, so the map and data are reached by signing in. Access is restricted to users with an account; no licence or cost is stated. Caveats: the content behind the login could not be seen, so the extent and currency of the layers are not known, and the site is in Vietnamese. Coverage is Vietnam. It supports flood and storm surge exposure analysis, dike failure and resilience studies, and emergency response planning for the lowland infrastructure the dikes protect; the related record is the SIAGUAPY water information system.
